summary: Iteration 3 backend + frontend verification for Consentalk. 80/80 backend pytest cases pass (54 pre-existing + 26 NEW for billing plans, billing/me, subscribe (mocked), cancel, free-tier room cap (1/day -> 402), free-tier image cap (3/session -> 402), admin/billing grant+revoke (super-admin and permission-gated admin), billing users/events listing, RBAC permissions catalog (16+), roles CRUD with invalid-perm filter, assign/revoke role with permission union+rebuild, admin analytics summary with permission gating). Frontend smoke: /premium region toggle (INR/USD), 4 plan cards across regions, admin-unlimited banner; /(tabs)/profile shows initials avatar (profile-name='SA · you') + menu-premium + menu-admin; /admin shows all 7 horizontally-scrollable tabs (users, reports, billing, roles, analytics, forensic, audit). NOTE: while admin tab buttons render and visually highlight when clicked, the tab BODY did not update to show billing-search/metric-*/role-name-input on the smoke session — likely a state-render bug. Also fixed a P0 frontend syntax error in app/admin/index.tsx that was breaking ALL routes.

ui_bugs.issue: Orphan duplicate StyleSheet fragment at end of file (lines 961-969 with `tyle: "italic"`) caused Metro SyntaxError 'Missing semicolon. (962:19)' which broke the WHOLE Expo web bundle (every route returned 500). Removed the dead block. After fix Metro bundles cleanly. This is a P0 blocker that would crash the deployed web build.

All 7 admin tab buttons render with correct testIDs and the active border updates on click, but the tab BODY content does not switch — after clicking admin-tab-billing the admin-billing-search input is not visible, after admin-tab-analytics no metric-* cells appear, after admin-tab-roles role-name-input is missing. The body keeps showing the empty-state ('Nothing to review here.'). Either the active-tab state is not driving the rendered section or the per-tab content is mounted off-screen/clipped. Needs main-agent investigation — likely a React state vs render-condition issue in the admin screen.

integration_issues.flow: Direct navigation to /admin without first hydrating session
integration_issues.issue: Hitting https://<host>/admin directly (with localStorage session_token already set by add_init_script) redirects to /auth because the admin route guard runs synchronously before AuthContext loads the token from storage. Workaround: navigate to /(tabs)/profile first then click menu-admin. Consider showing a loading state in admin index while AuthContext is still hydrating instead of immediate redirect.

action_items: Investigate admin dashboard tab-switching: clicking admin-tab-billing/roles/analytics highlights the tab but does not swap the body — verify the active-tab state variable in app/admin/index.tsx is wired into the renderTabContent switch / conditional. Per-tab testIDs (admin-billing-search, role-name-input, metric-*) need to be reachable from the rendered DOM.
Decide whether direct /admin URL should wait for AuthContext hydration instead of redirecting to /auth on initial render (fix race for super-admin deep links).
(Tracking only) server.py is now 1742 lines — split into routers/ before next iteration; same recommendation as iteration 2.

critical_code_review_comments: P0: app/admin/index.tsx had a stray syntax-broken trailing block (`tyle: "italic"` outside any object). This typo broke Metro for ALL routes — future code-review should run `tsc --noEmit` or eslint before commit.
Server.py keeps growing (1742 lines now); billing + RBAC + analytics blocks are clean but should land in routers/billing.py / routers/rbac.py / routers/admin.py.

_is_premium_active treats every admin/super-admin as premium — correct for quota bypass, but billing_me returns is_premium=true even for an admin who never subscribed; UI must use is_admin_unlimited (it does in /premium banner). OK but subtle.

billing.subscribe extends from existing premium_until if still in future — good. cancel only writes an event, does NOT clear is_premium until premium_until passes — acceptable but document this behavior.

RBAC revoke-role rebuilds permissions purely from remaining custom roles — this would drop any direct admin-set permissions like the test's manually-injected 'billing.grant'. If direct grants are intended to coexist with role grants, store them separately or reapply them on rebuild.
Admin billing/grant always overwrites premium_plan to the granted plan even if a longer plan was already active — minor UX nit.

rca_of_issue: Issue 1 (Metro syntax error): /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx had a trailing orphan block `tyle: \"italic\", backgroundColor: Colors.bg, padding:8, borderRadius:8, }, reportTime:..., empty:..., emptyText:..., });` after the legitimate StyleSheet.create() closing on line 960. This was almost certainly a bad copy-paste/auto-merge artefact — the canonical block (with correct `fontStyle: \"italic\"`) already existed earlier in the file (e.g. reportDetails). Metro could not parse it, every route returned 500. Reproduced by visiting any URL on the preview host; verified fix by removing lines 961-969 and observing /premium and /(tabs)/profile bundling and rendering correctly. Issue 2 (admin tab body not switching): not RCA'd — hand-off to main agent to inspect the tab state-to-render mapping in admin/index.tsx (likely the renderActiveTab / switch is missing the new tab-keys or is keyed off label vs key mismatch).
